svg.title: The posterior of one star
svg.desc: One star towards Orion, fitted with a parallax of 0.63 ± 0.09 mas. Left: posterior draws of distance and extinction, against the parallax range. Right: in each band, the range of the drawn models' magnitudes minus the observed magnitude, against the data error.
svg.text: bars: 95% of model draws; band: data ± 1σ
